entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I came to the Grand National Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: I came to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland to deliver a speech regarding the new Constitution and ask for the support of the Assembly before the upcoming vote.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked quickly through the corrid..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked quickly through the corridors, giving my greetings to people on my way towards the parliamentary hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I entered the hall, the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We both know that our Constitution..."
entries.dialogueText: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."
entries.menuText: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took my seat inside the special a..."
entries.dialogueText: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the centre of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "<shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must finally rewrite the Consti..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"
entries.menuText: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite her efforts, the argument c..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He murmured something from his seat..."
entries.dialogueText: He murmured something from his seat which was illegible from my position.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some MP's from the NFP side shouted..."
entries.dialogueText: Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We are not specifically cooperatin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."
entries.menuText: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at him."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at him.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""We have the President here with us..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have the President here with us today. He has asked to give an important announcement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm saddened to hear about your op..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."
entries.menuText: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I respect your opinion.""
entries.dialogueText: "I respect your opinion."
entries.menuText: "I respect your opinion."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pointed at me."
entries.dialogueText: She pointed at me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Mrs. Speaker.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do not stand against change! Be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."
entries.menuText: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""You have the floor, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have the floor, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Assembly fell silent."
entries.dialogueText: The Assembly fell silent.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We don't need you.""
entries.dialogueText: "We don't need you."
entries.menuText: "We don't need you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked to the stand as loud clapp..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't you dare stand against us! O..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the PFJP is guaranteed to be history."
entries.menuText: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the PFJP is guaranteed to be history."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and Gentlemen..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is you, who shouldn't use the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want your way to succeed but disregard our opinion."
entries.menuText: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want your way to succeed but disregard our opinion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Supreme Court holds too much p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court holds too much power over our elected branches! They have been obstructing the law making process and has long plagued the democracy in Sordland. Tarquin Soll gave this power to the Court for the sole reason to protect the Constitution of the 20's, which leads us to fail in adapting to the new world..."
entries.menuText: "The Supreme Court holds too much power..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our election threshold has harmed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything since the formation of our republic. As USP, we have governed for a long time and I can acknowledge that this success was partly the result of our current 10% percent threshold."
entries.menuText: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is time to strengthen the execu..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time to strengthen the executive to enact faster and more powerful reforms!"
entries.menuText: "It is time to strengthen the executive to enact faster and more powerful reforms!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I continued."
entries.dialogueText: I continued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""...Therefore, we propose changes t..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a fast changing new world!"
entries.menuText: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a fast changing new world!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will break the Supreme Court's..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."
entries.menuText: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will break down the obstacles be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will break down the obstacles before me!"
entries.menuText: "I will break down the obstacles before me!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will rebalance the branches of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."
entries.menuText: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is more important than ever tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is more important than ever that we stand united as a nation in these changing times. I call everybody to be part of the change our people has been calling for. We all want to make Sordland better, don't we? Let's embrace democracy and unite under the banner of our people, and surely Sordland will be great again!"
entries.menuText: Unity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud noises came from USP and NFP s..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. President, with all due respec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, with all due respect, I believe Sordland already has a functioning Constitution."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please don't interrupt me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't interrupt me."
entries.menuText: "Please don't interrupt me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."
entries.menuText: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and gentlemen of the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."
entries.menuText: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a breath and continued."
entries.dialogueText: I took a breath and continued.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is time to make a new Constitut..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"
entries.menuText: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I ask everyone to think clearly ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."
entries.menuText: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria looked at me to see if I'd f..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"
entries.menuText: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's write the future together!""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's write the future together!"
entries.menuText: "Let's write the future together!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I ask everyone to support us in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."
entries.menuText: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Be part of a new era for Sordland...."
entries.dialogueText: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."
entries.menuText: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will address all the problems of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"
entries.menuText: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""USP will change and lead Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"
entries.menuText: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For justice in Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For justice in Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For justice in Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria looked at me to see if I'd f..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a strong Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a strong Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For a strong Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a united Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a united Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For a united Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will bring change regardless of..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will bring change regardless of your support."
entries.menuText: "We will bring change regardless of your support."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""For a free Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "For a free Sordland!"
entries.menuText: "For a free Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your times have passed, Mr. Ricter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your times have passed, Mr. Ricter."
entries.menuText: "Your times have passed, Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Assembly roared with all kinds..."
entries.dialogueText: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."
entries.menuText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Thank you, Mrs. Speaker.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Thank you for the speech, Mr. Pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the speech, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honorable Members of the Grand Nat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honorable Members of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entries.menuText: "Honorable Members of Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I expect your support in the upcom..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Ricter."
entries.menuText: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Brothers and sisters! I am here to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brothers and sisters! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entries.menuText: "Brothers and sisters..."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""We will stand together with any at..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will stand together with any attempt to protect and strengthen our established political culture and national values. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Thank you, Mrs. Speaker.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "MP's kept shouting and responding t..."
entries.dialogueText: MP's kept shouting and responding to each other, creating a loud mess where nothing was legible.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our Constitution doesn't adequatel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers and the balance between the branches. In order to strengthen our democracy, we must be brave enough to point out the faults of our Constitution."
entries.menuText: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers..."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Order! Order! This topic has finis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Order! Order! This topic has finished. We are moving unto our next topic..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have always been overshadowed b..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have always been overshadowed by the Old Guard and the judiciary branch in Sordland. The Grand National Assembly and the President must be able to exercise their job properly and without obstruction. However, our current Constitution fails to guarantee this."
entries.menuText: "We have always been overshadowed by the Old Guard..."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I ask Mr. President to reevaluate..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask Mr. President to reevaluate his decision and not ignore the demands of our people! Otherwise you should never use the word 'democratic' again!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I slowly left the hall. The shoutin..."
entries.dialogueText: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I call everyone to stand by us to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"
entries.menuText: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""As long as Mr. President continues..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Mr. President continues to follow the footsteps of his party's founder, we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at him."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I got up from my seat and started m..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I just wanted to thank everybody f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."
entries.menuText: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I focused on..."
entries.dialogueText: I focused on...

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""However, our demands seemed to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, our demands seemed to be ignored by the government. Even though we made the reform committee's work possible, it was us, who were pushed back from the process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Ricter...""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter..."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Ricter..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We must not be afraid of change. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not be afraid of change. The world is changing, and Sordland needs the change it has earned after years of Sollism in the last decades. We will rewrite the old and make a constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and open the way for a democratic Sordland!"
entries.menuText: Change.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The '29 Constitution was the produ..."
entries.dialogueText: "The '29 Constitution was the product of a time of war. Now is a time for peace. As we must make peace between each other, we must strive for peace in the world. We need a more democratic constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and flourish in the upcoming times of peace and prosper!"
entries.menuText: Peace.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Kibener...""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Kibener..."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Kibener..."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I would like to thank Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would like to thank Mr. President for his speech. We, the People's Freedom and Justice Party, stands in agreement with the need for a new Constitution."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Yes, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just as I was about to continue spe..."
entries.dialogueText: Just as I was about to continue speaking, Gloria Tory interrupted me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I got up from my seat and started m..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"You and PFJP are nothing bu..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"You and PFJP are nothing but puppets of western interests!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked back to my seat as many MP..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked back to my seat as many MP's asked to speak. Frens Ricter was among them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yel..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yelling from his seat.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Yes, Mr. Ricter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I asked to speak."
entries.dialogueText: I asked to speak.
entries.menuText: Ask to speak.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to leave the Assembly and..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to leave the Assembly and its chaos behind.
entries.menuText: Leave the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Kesaro went back to his seat but th..."
entries.dialogueText: Kesaro went back to his seat but the chaos in the Assembly continued.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Mr. President!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tarquin Soll will answer for the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"
entries.menuText: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria gave him a stare. She looked..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria gave him a stare. She looked annoyed.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will be strengthening the presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be strengthening the presidential decrees."
entries.menuText: "We will be strengthening the presidential decrees."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked directly at me."
entries.dialogueText: He looked directly at me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will make Sordland great again!""
entries.dialogueText: "We will make Sordland great again!"
entries.menuText: "We will make Sordland great again!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's embrace the future.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's embrace the future."
entries.menuText: "Let's embrace the future."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some applauses came from the NFP an..."
entries.dialogueText: Some applauses came from the NFP and USP seats. Most of the others started to make loud noises again.

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""Let it be known that the NFP will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be known that the NFP will do its best to aid with the draft of the new constitution, and to reach an agreement with the USP. If our concerns are listened to, NFP has the power to make this proposal pass."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: "<shout>"You must have lost your min..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"You must have lost your mind to claim you were the reason for the reform talks, Mr. Ricter!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""The nationalist movement wants to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nationalist movement wants to thank Mr. Rayne for his priorities. The National Front Party will not stand in your way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You don't believe that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't believe that."
entries.menuText: "You don't believe that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The whole United Sordland Party sto..."
entries.dialogueText: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started applauding.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Tarquin Soll and his efforts canno..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarquin Soll and his efforts cannot be ignored. We must keep following the path he defined for Sordish people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We are not here to destroy Sollism..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."
entries.menuText: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I slowly left the hall. The shoutin..."
entries.dialogueText: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""...Very well, Mr. Kibener... Go ah..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Very well, Mr. Kibener... Go ahead."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""I'm sure the Honorable Members of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure the Honorable Members of USP will see that the President is acting rash by allying with the opposition to destroy the culture of Sollism that established Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Alright, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Alright, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""That was the extent of my quick no..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was the extent of my quick note. Thank you. The President has the floor."

entries.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
entries.title: Kesaro Kibener: ""I demand to speak!""
entries.dialogueText: "I demand to speak!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That was disrespectful Mrs. Speake..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."
entries.menuText: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: "<shout>"ORDER!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"ORDER!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."
entries.menuText: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll act as if that didn't happen.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."
entries.menuText: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Please continue your speech, Mr. P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please continue your speech, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It is a time of conflict and war...."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a time of conflict and war. The superpowers of the world are in a race to control the world. Terrorists and rebels around our borders continue to operate. We must be ready for what this new world will throw at us. We must be vigilant! More importantly, Rumburg is threatening our country more than ever. We need a stronger constitution that would strengthen our nation and prepare it for the upcoming times of conflict. And we will prevail!"
entries.menuText: War.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Give me the power to make Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give me the power to make Sordland great again!"
entries.menuText: "Give me the power to make Sordland great again!"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I saluted the crowd."
entries.dialogueText: I saluted the crowd.
entries.menuText: Salute the crowd.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I decided to read a poem before I e..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to read a poem before I ended my speech.
entries.menuText: Finish with a poem.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is a destiny above destiny...""
entries.dialogueText: "There is a destiny above destiny..."
entries.menuText: "There is a destiny above destiny..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is a victory growing with ev..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."
entries.menuText: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is my country, beyond my exi..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is my country, beyond my existence or nonexistence..."
entries.menuText: "There is my country, beyond my existence or nonexistence..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is a revolution, beyond our..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a revolution, beyond our and their existence..."
entries.menuText: "There is a revolution, beyond our and their existence..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is God, beyond existence and..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is God, beyond existence and nonexistence..."
entries.menuText: "There is God, beyond existence and nonexistence..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is the evil that tortures an..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."
entries.menuText: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There are songs to be sung in affe..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our battles..."
entries.menuText: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our battles..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""There is a spring that blossoms ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."
entries.menuText: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do not doubt the One! There is a d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."
entries.menuText: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Fear not when the dark falls! Ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."
entries.menuText: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do not dare call it defeat! There..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not dare call it defeat! There is a fortress made from my ashes."
entries.menuText: "Do not dare call it defeat! There is a fortress made from my ashes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Beyond the next morning, there is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."
entries.menuText: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured, your concerns will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'd like to have cooperation betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."
entries.menuText: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I welcome your positive attitude.""
entries.dialogueText: "I welcome your positive attitude."
entries.menuText: "I welcome your positive attitude."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your support. We are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the NFP."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the NFP."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for the nice words.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the nice words."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for the nice words."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I expect your support, Mr. Kibener..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect your support, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."
entries.menuText: "I expect your support, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""You've just promised to try Soll,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've just promised to try Soll, Mr. President! You are talking about the founder of this party. He is the true founder of this republic."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""What crimes are you talking about?..."
entries.dialogueText: "What crimes are you talking about? You owe everything you have to him. This is unacceptable!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud noises came from USP and NFP s..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hear me out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hear me out."
entries.menuText: "Hear me out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Everyone! Please! Let me finish.""
entries.dialogueText: "Everyone! Please! Let me finish."
entries.menuText: "Everyone! Please! Let me finish."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let me explain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me explain."
entries.menuText: "Let me explain."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The whole United Sordland Party sto..."
entries.dialogueText: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started shouting at me.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Your time is over. Please sit down..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your time is over. Please sit down, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Despite Mr. President here claimin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite Mr. President here claiming to serve justice by going against his party's founder, we know this to be some hogwash! Know that we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."
